initial_regression_on_rc28.scope: Initial saved-DXF enclosure test file before topology implementation; not all 36 new cases.

matching_face_pdf.method: Each published glyph label/source handles and bbox checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen excluding move-only contours without any segments at the PDF generation position; original DXF entity tags compared to rc28 in all cases after removing only recovery layer/XDATA. No source fonts used by runtime matching.

all_ten_saved_dxf.method: Fresh recognition of 84 saved DXFs with all ten unchanged r2 catalogs, cached after verified loading. Compare original geometry tags in every case; compare all preexisting recognition fields and entitydb tags except verified writer time for unchanged cases. Additional text must exactly extend the Jigmo row with 图. This is a DXF rerun, not 84 PDF conversions.

long_pdf.method: Four real open fonts; 97/193-character 20pt stroke and filled-Bezier PDFs with original advances. Normal Converter resource loading. Same original PDF bytes as rc28; compare saved rc28 source entity tags and text. Converter sampling and r2 catalogs are unchanged; the locked-font enclosure rule is exercised by the current matcher. Every glyph is checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen at its PDF position, with complete source handles/digests and saved TEXT insertion/alignment endpoints. Font files are used only to generate/audit fixtures, never by runtime recognition.
